fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are the JSON-LD NewsArticle/LiveBlogPosting object spread verbatim (20 Minutes runs live 'direct' blogs for sports/breaking news using LiveBlogPosting instead of NewsArticle, same articleBody field). Latest-mode records (S2-rss) come from the site-wide RSS feed, which uniquely includes a full-HTML <body> field alongside the usual RSS fields. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle/LiveBlogPosting).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, as carried directly in the JSON-LD block (no separate HTML scrape needed on this site).

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough); on latest-mode RSS records this is instead a plain string from the RSS <author> tag.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the RSS item (latest mode).

body.title: Body (RSS)
body.description: Full HTML article body carried in the RSS item's <body> CDATA field (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: List of <category> tags from the RSS item (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
